notes: Open mSupply is the mSupply Foundation's open-source LMIS for public health supply chains. It has no REST API and publishes no OpenAPI: the whole server surface is one GraphQL endpoint, POST {baseUrl}/graphql, body {query, variables}, response {data, errors}. upstream.json is the verbatim GraphQL introspection document fetched from the vendor's own demo server (apiVersion 3.1.0), and openapi.json is a mechanical conversion of it: every root field of Queries (152) and Mutations (156) becomes one operation, and every named GraphQL type (593 objects, 342 inputs, 268 unions, 126 enums, 120 interfaces) becomes a component schema, so this is the whole schema and not the slice the adaptor selects. Coverage is therefore full and the conversion is complete for query/mutation operations. Two deliberate modelling choices: (1) OpenAPI 3.0 allows one operation per method per path, so each root field is a distinct '/graphql#<field>' path variant carrying its own operationId and response envelope — at runtime every one of them is the same POST /graphql, and the generic '/graphql' operation (graphqlRequest) is the adaptor's query() helper; (2) output object schemas declare no required properties, because a GraphQL response only carries the fields the caller's selection set asked for, so even a non-null field is absent unless selected. Not converted as operations: the three Subscriptions root fields (ping, syncInfoUpdated, initialisationStatusUpdated), which are served over the GraphQL subscription transport rather than an HTTP POST; their types are still present under components.schemas. The adaptor surface was cross-checked against the schema — getItemsWithStats runs root field 'items', insertOutboundShipment runs 'insertOutboundShipment', upsertOutboundShipment runs 'batchOutboundShipment', and the implicit login runs the 'authToken' query — all four exist in upstream.json with the argument names the adaptor passes. The specUrl is a live server, so upstream.contentHash will move whenever the demo is upgraded; that is a genuine upstream-changed signal, not a capture error. servers[0].url is the vendor demo; real deployments are self-hosted and set by the adaptor's baseUrl credential.
